audit.adaptation_reason: The source question omits the folding premise, which is necessary to relate the crease to the reflected strip edges. Made that depicted operation explicit while preserving all visible edges and the original target.
source_visual_observations: A horizontal strip with original right-hand boundary dashed; folded extension has sloping parallel edges, a perpendicular end, and creaseQR; angle1=140° and unknown2.
audit.independent_solution: The reflected strip edge makes180−140=40° with the original horizontal edge. Reflection across the crease makes the crease bisect the140° angle between the original rightward edge and its reflected down-left direction, so the crease inclination is70° below horizontal. Angle2 is its supplement,110°, choice B.
